name: mental-health-platform
description: Mental health assessment and assistance platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm start -w api
scripts.test: npm run test -w web && npm run test -w api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web && npm run lint -w api
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install -w web && npm install -w api
